title: [E16-02] Responsive Accessible Critical User Journeys
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-02 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to ship a responsive accessible application, so I can support varied users.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P0  
**Target Release:** B — Competition prototype — 10 December 2026  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 3 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P0`, `release:B`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-11.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Keyboard and small-screen critical flows tested; reduced-motion honored.
- [ ] Make buyer RFQ, artisan decisions/progress and operator review usable on small screens.
- [ ] Provide labels, keyboard controls, visible focus and understandable validation.
- [ ] Respect reduced motion and provide accessible text alternatives/status announcements.
- [ ] Test representative low-end device/browser conditions and fix blocking barriers.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Use shared accessible UI components and record supported browser/device assumptions; avoid unsupported blanket compliance claims.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Complete critical tasks by keyboard and mobile viewport, review contrast/labels and document remaining observed limitations.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.

**Release Boundary:** Use isolated synthetic commercial records and distinguish simulation, observed evidence and physical hardware. This story does not authorize real contracts or live money movement.
